evidence.notes: Approval request DTO getters and setters preserve local fields; Approval.process remains explicit unsupported.

source.content: @isTest private class ApprovalDtoContractsTest { @isTest static void requestAndResultDtosKeepFields() { Approval.ProcessRequest base = new Approval.ProcessRequest(); base.setComments('base comment'); base.setNextApproverIds(new List<Id>{ '005000000000001' }); System.assertEquals('base comment', base.getComments()); System.assertEquals('005000000000001', base.getNextApproverIds().get(0)); Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest submit = new Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest(); submit.setComments('submit comment'); submit.setNextApproverIds(new List<Id>{ '005000000000002' }); submit.setObjectId('001000000000001'); submit.setProcessDefinitionNameOrId('Account_Approval'); submit.setSkipEntryCriteria(true); submit.setSubmitterId('005000000000001'); System.assertEquals('submit comment', submit.getComments()); System.assertEquals('005000000000002', submit.getNextApproverIds().get(0)); System.assertEquals('001000000000001', submit.getObjectId()); System.assertEquals('Account_Approval', submit.getProcessDefinitionNameOrId()); System.assertEquals(true, submit.getSkipEntryCriteria()); System.assertEquals('005000000000001', submit.getSubmitterId()); Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest work = new Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest(); work.setAction('Approve'); work.setComments('work comment'); work.setNextApproverIds(new List<Id>{ '005000000000003' }); work.setWorkitemId('04i000000000001'); System.assertEquals('Approve', work.getAction()); System.assertEquals('work comment', work.getComments()); System.assertEquals('005000000000003', work.getNextApproverIds().get(0)); System.assertEquals('04i000000000001', work.getWorkitemId()); Approval.ProcessResult result = new Approval.ProcessResult(); result.success = true; result.errors = new List<Database.Error>(); result.actorIds = new List<Id>{ '005000000000001' }; result.entityId = '001000000000001'; result.instanceId = '04g000000000001'; result.instanceStatus = 'Approved'; result.newWorkitemIds = new List<Id>{ '04i000000000001' }; System.assertEquals(true, result.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(0, result.getErrors().size()); System.assertEquals('005000000000001', result.getActorIds().get(0)); System.assertEquals('001000000000001', result.getEntityId()); System.assertEquals('04g000000000001', result.getInstanceId()); System.assertEquals('Approved', result.getInstanceStatus()); System.assertEquals('04i000000000001', result.getNewWorkitemIds().get(0)); } }
